title: Relative tensor stalk homology identified with a local derived module tensor
statement: Let X,Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X\to Y a morphism, K a cochain complex of structure modules, V an open subset of X, and L any cochain complex of structure modules on the site over V. Choose the global and open derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and an isomorphism between the restriction of QK to V and QL. Fix y in V and a derived category of modules over A=O_{Y,f(y)}. Let P be a K-flat complex of f^{-1}O_Y-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] and q:P\to K restricted along f^{-1}O_Y\to O_X a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. For each f^{-1}O_Y-module sheaf F there exists an A-module M such that, for every integer i, the underlying abelian-group stalk at y of H^i(Tot(P tensor F[0])) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is isomorphic to the underlying abelian group of H^i(Q(restrict_{f_y} S_{V,y} L) tensor_A^L M[0]). Here S_{V,y} is the explicit open module stalk functor [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor]. M is the stalk of F transported along the canonical inverse-image ring stalk isomorphism. No boundedness, projectivity, perfectness or Tor assumption is made on L.

proof.text: Use the inverse-image ring stalk isomorphism to transport F_y to the A-module M. Exact restriction to V and the open stalk functor send eL to a derived isomorphism between the global stalk of K and S_{V,y}L; cofinality of the neighbourhoods inside V and the open immersion stalk ring isomorphism identify these stalks. Scalar restriction along the actual f.stalkMap preserves homology and quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text: Apply the K-flat stalk criterion to the ringed space with ring sheaf f inverse image O_Y. Transport its K-flat stalk to A and take the stalk of q, a quasi-isomorphism onto the scalar-restricted stalk of K. Therefore its derived object is the scalar-restricted S_{V,y}L. Tensoring with M[0] preserves this derived isomorphism. A common K-flat resolution and invariance of tensor under quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes compute the left tensor by the prescribed stalk complex.

proof.text: Stalks commute with total tensor and the degree-zero single complex. Exactness of stalks commutes with degree-i homology. Compose these identifications with the derived tensor comparison from the preceding step, and forget A-module structure. The resulting abelian-group isomorphism holds for every i with the same M. This includes acyclic or zero models and all negative degrees.

theorem relativeTensor_stalk_localModel_homology_iso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (V : X.Opens)
    (L : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ)
    (eL : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L))
    (y : X) (hy : y ∈ V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)))]
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf))) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf) P)
    (q : P ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
          (Modules.tensorPullbackRingMap f))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) (hq : QuasiIso q) :
    ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
            (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf)),
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)), ∀ i : ℤ,
          Nonempty ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X.carrier ⋙
            TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} y).obj
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
                ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P
                  ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F)
                  (@MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory
                    (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf)))).homology i)) ≅
            (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) i).obj
                  (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                    (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap y).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
                      (.up ℤ)).obj
                        (((openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨y, hy⟩).mapHomologicalComplex
                          (.up ℤ)).obj L)) ⊗
                    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                      (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) 0).obj M)))
